A commitment to better movement

Walking, climbing stairs, working, exercising and sleeping can all become more difficult when you are in pain. A consultation is a chance to look beyond the immediate symptoms and discuss the activities you would like to return to.

Care planning can take into account your condition, symptoms, lifestyle, activity level, overall health and long-term goals. Your clinician can explain the findings and discuss options suited to your circumstances.

Areas of orthopaedic care

Dr. Anuj’s stated areas of practice include robotic joint replacement, sports medicine, pain and regenerative medicine, and ortho rheumatology. Consultations provide an opportunity to discuss concerns affecting joints, mobility and recovery.

  • Robotic joint replacement: discuss assessment, surgical planning and whether a robotic-assisted approach is appropriate.
  • Knee and hip concerns: talk about pain, stiffness, arthritis and the effect on everyday movement.
  • Sports injuries: discuss assessment and recovery after an activity-related injury.
  • Shoulder concerns: seek guidance for pain, stiffness or difficulty reaching and lifting.
  • Pain and regenerative medicine: discuss available options, their evidence, benefits and risks.
  • Ortho rheumatology: discuss joint-related concerns and appropriate evaluation.

For fractures, trauma or other complex conditions, contact the clinic to confirm the care available and whether a specialist referral is appropriate.

Qualifications and professional focus

Dr. Anuj Patwari’s qualifications are MBBS, DNB (Orthopaedics), FIRJR, FIAS. He is a Consultant Robotic Joint Replacement Surgeon, Sports Medicine Specialist, Pain and Regenerative Medicine Specialist, and Ortho Rheumatologist.

Experience that supports your decisions

With 7 years of experience and 2000+ successful surgeries, Dr. Anuj combines his professional focus on robotic surgery with individual consultation. Each person’s condition and recovery are different, and outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

Robotic-assisted orthopaedic surgery

Robotic technology can assist the surgical team with planning and selected steps of a joint replacement procedure. The surgeon’s clinical judgement guides the treatment plan. During a consultation, ask how the technology is used, whether it is suitable for you and what alternatives are available.

Care for different stages of life

Orthopaedic concerns affect people with different ages, activity levels and goals. A young athlete, an adult experiencing joint pain and an older person with reduced mobility may each need a different approach. Assessment and, where appropriate, referral help identify the next step.

Concerns to discuss

People seek orthopaedic advice for many reasons, including knee or hip pain, shoulder stiffness, sports injuries, ligament or tendon concerns, joint instability and difficulty moving comfortably. Share when symptoms began, how they affect your day and any previous treatment or reports.

A considered approach to treatment

Not every orthopaedic concern requires surgery. Depending on the diagnosis, non-surgical options may include activity changes, rehabilitation, medication or other interventions. Your clinician can explain the potential benefits and risks and discuss when a surgical opinion may be appropriate.

Personalised rehabilitation and recovery

Recovery planning can include improving movement, rebuilding strength, reducing stiffness and supporting a gradual return to daily activities or sport. A rehabilitation plan and follow-up should be tailored to your condition and progress.

Communication and compassionate care

It is natural to have questions about pain, procedures or recovery. Ask for a clear explanation of your condition, the options available, expected follow-up and any costs. Bringing a family member, a list of medicines and relevant scans or reports can help you prepare.

Technology and specialist support

Imaging, surgical technology and rehabilitation support may form part of a treatment journey when appropriate. Availability and the facilities used depend on the planned care; please ask the clinic about arrangements for your consultation or procedure.
